guarantees: A requirement names its consumer and intended use.
Every threshold has a unit, comparison and evaluation scope.
Fitness is relative to a named use and consumer.
A fitness verdict cannot be generalized beyond its assessed scope.
A metric specifies procedure, unit and subject.
Composite scores publish weighting and missing-component behavior.
A contract edition is immutable after activation.
Every obligation names obligor, beneficiary and scope.
Observed properties retain sample window and provenance.
Observation never mutates the declared contract.
A report binds the exact schema and data identities.
Validator failure is distinct from instance nonconformance.
Rules declare target grain and missingness semantics.
Severity does not alter the observed outcome.
Every result binds rule, engine, data cut and time.
Skipped, errored, passed and failed remain distinct.
Fixtures are versioned and isolated from production truth.
Expected outcomes are reviewed independently of actual results.
Profiles state population or sample scope.
Approximate statistics disclose error or sketch parameters.
Baseline selection precedes current-window scoring.
Baseline drift never silently changes a contractual threshold.
Anomaly scores retain detector and baseline editions.
An anomaly is a signal requiring adjudication, not a defect verdict.
Statistical significance and practical significance remain separate.
Shift results identify both populations and feature mappings.
Event time and observation order are explicit.
Detector reset is recorded as a state transition.
Telemetry identities correlate to data cut, run and rule.
Instrumentation does not become the authority for business correctness.
Correlation edges record method and confidence.
Correlation never upgrades temporal association to causation.
SLI numerator and denominator are typed and reproducible.
SLO compliance is windowed and does not certify individual records.
Alert lifecycle is distinct from incident lifecycle.
Silence never changes the underlying measurement.
Case state is independent from dataset publication state.
Closure records resolution reason and residual risk.
Verdicts retain decision authority and evidence.
Unresolved cases remain unknown rather than defaulting to defect.
Each side has a named truth role; roles need not be symmetric.
Tolerance includes unit, sign, rounding and aggregation grain.
A run binds both data cuts and the definition edition.
Matched, unmatched, ambiguous and incomparable remain separate.
Break history is append-only.
Closure names resolution, evidence and any correcting entries.
Original values remain addressable.
Proposal records derivation, scope and reversibility.
Correction never erases its source evidence.
Every applied change references an approved proposal.
Quarantine scope is exact and does not imply defect verdict.
Release requires current evidence for the same data cut.
Attestations bind subject digest, criteria edition, issuer and validity.
Revocation status is independently checkable.
Evidence identifies subject, method, actor and time.
Redaction preserves a verifiable statement of omitted scope.
Waivers are scoped, expiring and attributable.
Waiver changes disposition, never the measured result.
Reference edition and effective time are explicit.
Mapping preserves whether it was exact, deprecated, inferred or manual.
Truth roles are declared for each assertion and period.
An adjustment never rewrites the operational source observation.
Probabilistic links retain score and model edition.
Merge is a separate authorized correction.
Completeness denominator and expected population are explicit.
Freshness and event-time lateness remain distinct.
Sample design is fixed before results are interpreted.
Acceptance decision records producer and consumer risks.
Impact edges retain lineage kind and data version.
Potential impact is distinct from observed corruption.
Policy applicability is resolved before enforcement.
Policy change does not rewrite historical evaluations.
Verification uses criteria independent of repair mechanics.
Acceptance identifies residual exceptions and monitoring horizon.
